Maya (CSM): Hey team — sync for Borealis dedicated bring-up. We need final agreement on quota numbers, autoscale headroom, and a short load rehearsal with them next week. Tentative window: Tue 10:00-11:00 UTC. Can everyone confirm availability? :calendar:
Ravi (Solutions Engineer): I can do Tue 10 UTC. Suggest we run three phases: smoke (10m), ramp (20m), soak (30m). Will use the same k6 script we used for Nova but with a 3x token size.
Linus (Eng Infra): Tue works for infra. Quick notes: 
- Node sizing: we'll attach an extra reserved pool of 6 A100s for the rehearsal.
- Autoscale policy: keep reactive scaler on but cap burst to 12 nodes to avoid overspend.
- Prefix priming: recommend priming top 200 prompts to warm KV cache before ramp.
Maya (CSM): @Eve - Borealis are those times ok on your side? Also FYI renewal review is on Wed; this rehearsal helps show performance story.
Eve - Borealis: Tue 10 UTc works. Quick asks: 1) blackout windows — we need a fallback to hosted if latency >1.2s for 2 consecutive mins? 2) Can you share the traffic template so we can map to our user concurrency?
Ravi (Solutions Engineer): Good Qs. For fallback we have a policy: model routing will spill to hosted-generic if p95 > 1.5s for >90s. We can tighten threshold to 1.2s for the rehearsal only.
Traffic template (k6) snippet:
```
export default function () {
  http.post('https://dedicated.redwood/api/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: randomPrompt(), max_tokens: 1024}), {headers: {Authorization: `Bearer ${__ENV.TOKEN}`}});
}
```
Ramp profile: 5 -> 150 VUs over 20m, then 150 for 30m. We'll simulate 3 token-size tiers.
Linus (Eng Infra): Priming script: run a single-thread prefix load for 15m right before the ramp start. I'll schedule a warmup job: `warmup-job --prompts-file borealis-top200.json --concurrency 8 --duration 900s`.
Maya (CSM): Ops checklist draft (quick):
- Confirm reserved pool allocated (Linus)
- Push autoscale config with burst cap (Linus)
- Share k6 script and env instructions (Ravi)
- Customer runbook + rollback steps (Maya)
- Monitor dashboard: per-token cost, p95 latency, error rate, dropped requests (everyone)
Can we lock these by EOD Friday?
Eve - Borealis: Looks good. For rollback: can you document the exact route switch command? We want a single button fallback. Also please include who to page if we see errors.
deploy-bot: Scheduled event created: "Borealis - Dedicated Rehearsal" Tue 3650004834 10:00 UTC. Organizer: Maya (CSM). Reminder set 30m before.
Ravi (Solutions Engineer): For route switch we'll supply a one-line CLI: `redwood route set --team borealis --target hosted-generic --reason "rehearsal fallback"`. I'll add contact list: 24/7 on-call: eng-infra, oncall-solutions, maya-csm.
Linus (Eng Infra): I'll allocate pool by Mon 18:00 UTC and post the pool id here. Also will set a temporary stricter autoscale threshold for the rehearsal as requested.
Maya (CSM): Perfect. I'll update the customer success playbook and add a short slide for the renewal meeting showing expected p95 and cost delta. Anyone else? :thumbsup:
Eve - Borealis: Thanks — appreciate the clarity. We'll run a pre-probe on Mon (10m) to validate auth and endpoint reachability.
Ravi (Solutions Engineer): One more thing: capture a few sample logs during the soak for quality signals. We'll forward those to Borealis for their QA.
Maya (CSM): OK locking schedule: Mon pre-probe 10:00 UTC (10m), Tue rehearsal 10:00-11:00 UTC. Action owners: Linus (pool + autoscale), Ravi (k6 + route cli + logs), Maya (runbook + renewal slide), Eve (customer-side probe). I'll ping on Friday if anything outstanding.
Eve - Borealis: See you then. :wave:
Linus (Eng Infra): I'll post pool id + autoscale snapshot when done.
Ravi (Solutions Engineer): k6 script + env vars uploaded to GDrive: https://drive.redwood/bor-rehearsal/k6.
Maya (CSM): Thanks all — closing thread unless someone needs to add follow-ups.
